The whole history of a chat loads again when you scroll up, and six more differences from Telegram
Desktop reported on the last build are fixed: reactions, the chat menu, the profile window, voice
messages, media spoilers and sticker sets.

**If Rustgram updated itself to v0.2.0-alpha.4 and no longer starts** (Windows says
"avutil-61.dll was not found"): v0.2.0-alpha.4 was available for about 15 minutes, and its update
left out the media libraries the new version needs. To repair the copy, unzip
`rustgram-0.2.0-alpha.6-win-x64-portable.zip` over the folder that holds `rustgram.exe` and replace
all files, or, for a copy installed with the installer, run `Rustgram-Setup-0.2.0-alpha.6-win-x64.exe`.
Then start Rustgram. Your accounts, chats and settings are not affected.

**If the menu says "New version is ready · v0.2.0-alpha.4":** do not restart to install it. Quit
Rustgram, delete the `tupdates` folder in Rustgram's data folder (`%APPDATA%\Rustgram` by default)
and start Rustgram again; it then downloads this release. Other copies update to this release by
themselves.

## Highlights

- **No more missing messages.** Scrolling a chat up could jump from the newest messages to the very
  first one and skip everything between them; this also happened in v0.2.0-alpha.2. Every message
  now loads, in every kind of chat and in both directions.
- **Reactions show who reacted.** With a few reactions the small profile photos are shown instead of
  a number, and under a photo the reactions sit below the bubble, like Telegram Desktop.
- **The chat menu is complete.** The "three dots" menu of a group, channel or user has all its rows
  with icons (manage, boost, poll, export, clear history, leave and more) instead of one row.
- **The profile opens as a window over the chat** when you click the chat title; the info button
  still toggles the right column.
- **Voice messages** are laid out like Telegram Desktop (the speed switch lives in the player bar).
- **Media spoilers** hide the photo or video under a blurred, darkened image with moving particles.
- **Sticker sets show their pictures** in the set box, and a sticker whose download link expired is
  fetched again instead of staying empty.

<details>
<summary>All changes</summary>

### Fixed

- A history made of separately loaded parts never shows them as neighbours; the part between them is
  requested from the server.
- Jumping to a message that is not loaded opens the messages around it.
- A history page that failed to load is retried after two seconds.
- Reactions: recent reactors' profile photos, the light pill below media bubbles.
- The chat menu follows Telegram Desktop for users, bots, groups, supergroups, channels and forums.
- A click on the chat title or on "View group info" opens the profile as a layer; Esc, the × and a
  click outside close it.
- With two accounts, the right column no longer comes back after a restart.
- The voice bubble's play button, waveform and transcribe button sit where Telegram Desktop puts
  them under a sender name.
- Spoilers on photos, videos and album items reveal with a short fade; no "Spoiler" label.
- The sticker set box downloads its stickers' pictures.

### Known issues

- Albums and scheduled media still upload while the window waits.
- Text is drawn slightly differently from Telegram Desktop 7.4.7, which changed its text rendering.
- Seven chat menu rows are not there yet: topics, stories, wallpaper and translation.

</details>

## Install or update

- **Installer:** `Rustgram-Setup-0.2.0-alpha.6-win-x64.exe`.
- **Portable:** unzip `rustgram-0.2.0-alpha.6-win-x64-portable.zip` and run `rustgram.exe`.
- Installed copies update themselves (pre-releases: beta channel only).
- Check a download: `gh attestation verify <file> -R murmaider227/rustgram`, or compare it with
  `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
